4.name: Fish Out of Water
4.overview: The players waste no time diving into action, and Eve is the first one to jump in with a twist on a classic guessing game. An unusual fishing presentation and an over-the-top hip-shaking contest soon follow, causing quite a stir. But it's Guy's aquatic performance that really makes a splash, leaving everyone gasping for air!

4.name: Silent but Deadly
4.overview: Just as she starts to recover from a surprise visit by a legendary gossip columnist, Liliane is put on the spot for a bold and smelly performance. Mehdi follows with a daring act that has the players sympathizing with pain, but all they can do is wince. And just when they think it can't get any worse, a stinky sausage game pushes everyone to the edge.

4.name: Farmyard Frenzy
4.overview: A mysterious mime presents a workshop, but there's something about his outfit that catches the eye. Mégan hosts an agricultural fair and introduces a greased pig competition, only to be overshadowed by two unexpected guests. As the players struggle to keep it together, Anthony shows up as a life coach dishing out some highly questionable advice.

4.name: Odour in the Court
4.overview: Patrick and Claude take the gang on a wild taxi ride, which leads to a mysterious fart and a Thelma & Louise twist! The trip ends in controversy, calling for an attorney who only makes matters worse. Then Patrick launches a compliment challenge that spirals out of control, pushing some players to the brink!

4.name: Pottery and Poetry
4.overview: Phil's theatrical acts take an unexpected turn when a Ghost-style pottery scene falls into the hands of Patrice and an accomplice. But it's Guylaine who steals the show with her fiery feminist poems and a surprise kiss that sends one player completely over the edge. The clock is ticking! Who will reach the final round?

4.name: The Final Countdown
4.overview: All the players return to the mansion to listen in as two sports analysts break down the final hours of the game. With too many players still standing, Patrick launches a tournament to settle the score. The final two battle it out with flying chocolate cake and absurd jokes, concluding in an epic recap. Who will claim victory?

overview: Patrick Huard invites 10 comedians to this unique experience that borders on torture. They will spend six hours together in an enclosed space where it is forbidden to laugh. The last one to laugh will win the contest, as well as $100,000 for the foundation of their choice.

seasons.name: Season 2

seasons.name: Season 3

Watch them compete and try to make their opponents crack while keeping a straight face. Who will win the $100,000 for charity?

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Prepare to lose your mind in this fourth season of LOL: Who Laughs Last! Dive into a six-hour whirlwind of madness as Patrick Huard, from his control room, oversees 10 new headliners ready to do anything to kill each other... with laughter. Between outrageous pranks, absurd costumes, and biting one-liners, watch these masters of comedy battle their own laughter to be the last ones standing. Who will manage to keep a straight face and win the grand prize of $100,000 for their chosen cause?
